title: Forecrew toolbox
description: Schema of packs/toolboxes/<name>.yaml: the image an agent job runs in when its role names the toolbox (roles.md, toolbox), with the CLIs and MCP servers it offers the agent. Jobs with a toolbox need a worker with the docker label. Resolved, it is the toolbox of an agent job's spec (job-spec.md). It never holds secrets; MCP servers get secrets only by naming variables of the job's credentials. internal/roles validates it (this schema, then domain.Toolbox.Validate).

name.description: Must equal the file name without .yaml.

image.description: Image to pull, with a pinned tag or digest.

dockerfile.description: Dockerfile to build, relative to packs/toolboxes; that directory is the build context.

needs.description: Worker labels the job needs besides docker, which is implied.

version.description: Command printing the tool's version, recorded with the job.

mcp_servers.description: stdio MCP servers the agent CLI starts inside the container.

env.description: Non-secret variables. Names that are, or end in _ followed by, TOKEN, SECRET, PASSWORD or KEY (any case) are refused.

credential_env.description: Names of variables of the job's env (its credentials, job-spec.md) passed to the server. The only way a secret reaches it.
